ZTI 1×8 PLC Fiber Optic Splitter – High-Performance FTTH Passive Component


The ZTI 1×8 PLC Fiber Optic Splitter is a premium-grade passive optical component designed for modern FTTH, FTTX, EPON, GPON, and PON networks. Engineered with advanced Planar Lightwave Circuit (PLC) technology, this splitter delivers stable optical distribution with excellent wavelength stability, low insertion loss, and high reliability—making it the ideal choice for telecom operators, ISPs, and enterprise fiber infrastructures in Bangladesh.


Built for long-distance single-mode applications, the ZTI 1×8 PLC Splitter ensures consistent signal performance across the full 1260–1650nm wavelength window. Whether you’re expanding an FTTH network, setting up distribution points, or connecting multiple subscribers, this splitter guarantees top-tier durability and uniformity.


Key Features


  • 1×8 Splitting Ratio – One input fiber to eight balanced output fibers
  • High-Precision PLC Technology – Stable and uniform optical signal distribution
  • Low Insertion Loss & High Return Loss – Ensures superior signal integrity
  • Wide Operating Wavelength (1260–1650nm) – Perfect for PON/GPON/EPON systems
  • Compact & Durable Design – Suitable for ODF, joint box, and distribution box installations
  • Connector Options – SC/UPC, SC/APC, LC/UPC, LC/APC (as required)
  • High Reliability & Temperature Resistance – Operates smoothly from −40°C to +85°C
  • Ideal for FTTH Deployments – Designed for Bangladesh fiber networks
